scope: Repository metadata and pinned trees; detailed Doan comparison for VMaNGOS, CMaNGOS and actual bound Forever Classic implementation. Not a claim of complete source audit.

sources.description: Progressive Vanilla Core aimed at all versions from 1.2 to 1.12
sources.use: Vanilla boss/escort/event scripts and progressive database updates. Existing Everlake Classic Doan explicitly ports this project.
sources.compatibility: ScriptDev2 API and old client schema; existing ports must be deduplicated. Same lineage as CMaNGOS for many encounters.

sources.description: C(ontinued)-MaNGOS (Classic fork) is about: -- Doing WoW-Emulation Right!
sources.use: ScriptDevAI boss, escort, outdoor event and quest behavior comparisons.
sources.compatibility: CMaNGOS APIs and DB script tables differ from Trinity. Classic timings need Forever observations.

sources.description: A content database for mangos-classic, and World of Warcraft Client Patch 1.12
sources.use: Classic spawns, paths, quests, loot and DB scripts.
sources.compatibility: Targets 1.12; cannot supply new Forever recipes or establish current availability.

sources.description: TrinityCore Open Source MMO Framework (master = 12.1.5.70783, 3.3.5 = 3.3.5a.12340, cata classic =  4.4.2.60895)
sources.use: Core framework, SmartAI and historical branch encounter implementations.
sources.compatibility: Default master is modern retail; use matching Classic or 3.3.5 behavior only after checking redesign and schema changes.

sources.description: Complete Open Source and Modular solution for MMO
sources.compatibility: Wrath mechanics, difficulty, API and spell IDs may differ. Per-file license review needed.

sources.use: Bracket-selected script and SQL overrides for comparison.
sources.compatibility: AzerothCore module API differs. AGPL-3.0 metadata: not copied into GPL-2-only code; full licensing compatibility review needed before code reuse.

sources.description: ForeverCore: a Blizzlike server for the WoW Forever client (Classic 1.60.1), based on TrinityCore. Optional player bots on the forever-bots branch.
sources.use: Direct Forever-compatible core upstream and existing Classic ports. Compare target pinned core before copying.
sources.compatibility: Everlake baseline is 343fe6fb; latest head differs. Source alone does not prove compiled registration or runtime behavior.

sources.description: Mangos ZERO is a server for World of Warcraft. The server serves full world content including authentication & scripts support. Compatible with World of Warcraft clients 1.12.1-1.12.3 - Report all issues at https://www.getmangos.eu/bug-tracker/mangos-zero/
sources.use: Vanilla 1.12 server encounter and quest implementations.
sources.compatibility: Different engine API and schema. Check shared ScriptDev lineage before treating as corroboration.

sources.description: The *MangosZero* world database containing creatures, npcs etc.to populate the game world with. Report all issues at https://www.getmangos.eu/bug-tracker/mangos-zero/
sources.use: Vanilla world-data research lead. README targets 1.12.1–1.12.3, explicitly excludes 1.13+.
sources.compatibility: Repository license metadata is NOASSERTION; verify actual file/data grant before redistribution. Not imported.

sources.description: Mangos ONE is a server for World of Warcraft: The Burning Crusade. The server serves full world content including authentication & scripts support. Compatible with World of Warcraft client 2.4.3(8606). Report all issues at https://www.getmangos.eu/bug-tracker/mangos-one/ - Playable.
